text:
Morgan: FYI launching a pilot for 'deferred overage reporting' to give customers more invoice visibility before hard-charges. Summary below.
Morgan: TL;DR: 1) Overages will be recorded in a holding ledger for up to one billing cycle for eligible accounts; they will be visible on a provisional invoice but not charged until the next invoice unless customer opts into immediate payment. 2) Customers get a 7-day review window to dispute or accept provisional overages; disputed items trigger a manual review flow. 3) Pilot is opt-in for starter and growth tiers only.
Sam: Important: this changes billing cadence for overage line items only. No change to runtime enforcement or rate limits. Throttles still apply in real-time.
Tanya: Finance note: need GL mapping for provisional overage rows (`overage_provisional`) and guidance on recognition timing — we'll treat as memo items until accepted. Tax team looped.
Ari: Legal: add pilot clause: "Provisional overages are recorded for review and not final until invoiced; company reserves right to invoice accepted or unresolved provisional items." Also ensure dispute SLA wording is clear.
Support: We'll prepare the customer-facing FAQ and dispute playbook; need sample provisional invoice screenshots and opt-in text for the billing console.
Ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: `deploy/billing/2028-02-24/deferred-overage-v1` at 2028-02-24T01:00:00Z (2971503600). Expect a short migration job to mark eligible accounts.
Billing-bot: INFO: migration will backfill provisional overages for the prior 30 days for opt-ins; backfill can be disabled per-account.
Sam: Implementation: new invoice metadata `provisional=true` and line item `overage_provisional`. We'll surface a provisional invoice in the console under Billing -> Provisional Invoices.
Tanya: Monitoring: add metrics `billing.provisional_count`, `billing.provisional_accepted_pct`, `billing.provisional_dispute_rate`. Alert if dispute rate >2% or reconciliation mismatch >0.25%.
Morgan: Rollout plan: opt-in cohort 100 accounts tomorrow, expand if reconciliation & disputes within tolerance. We will email pilot participants with details and a one-click opt-out.
Support: Draft FAQ link: https://docs.redwood/support/deferred-overage-reporting.md (WIP). Will prepare canned responses for disputes.
Ari: Also recommend adding expiry metadata `provisional_expires_at` and clear UI copy: "If not disputed, provisional items will appear on your next invoice."
Sam: Action items: Eng (Sam) finish toggle & UI, Finance (Tanya) GL mapping & reconciliation rules, Legal (Ari) finalize wording, Support prepare FAQ and playbook.
Billing-bot: INFO: deploy started at 2028-02-24T01:00:12Z (2971503612).
Morgan: Quick update: deploy completed. Backfill started for 100 opt-ins; initial provisional invoice samples look correct. Will post 72h summary. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
